headline: Approved up to $1,892,556.56 in technology contracts for the new South Kingstown High School and $44,086.85 for library cameras.
summary: Alfred E. Bucco was sworn in as police chief, and the Indoor Shooting Range License for 371 Rose Hill Road was renewed after a public hearing. Contracts for culvert engineering and audiovisual equipment were also approved, along with a roster of names for a Revolutionary War memorial. Residents of Pond Street asked for a stop sign, and that request was referred for a traffic study.
decisions: Approved the Town Manager's appointment of Alfred E. Bucco as Chief of Police, effective November 9, 2026, unanimously.
Approved the minutes of the October 22 and October 26, 2026 regular sessions, unanimously.
Accepted the minutes of the October 26, 2026 closed executive session, unanimously.
Reappointed Sharon Henderson to the Historic District Commission, term to expire in December 2029, unanimously.
Reappointed Stephen Stewart to the Saugatucket Veterans’ Memorial Park Commission, term to expire in January 2030, unanimously.
Appointed Michaela Barden to the Conservation Commission, term to expire in November 2029, unanimously.
Appointed William Rosen to the Conservation Commission, term to expire in November 2029, unanimously.
Appointed David Brown to the Bicycle-Pedestrian Advisory Committee, term to expire in November 2028, unanimously.
Approved the consent agenda, including the items marked (CA), unanimously.
Authorized a contract award of $12,513.00 to Ockers Technologies for audiovisual equipment in the Town Hall Conference Room, unanimously.
Authorized a contract award to Marcus Communications for UHF radio maintenance, not to exceed $12,442.11 for fiscal year 2027, unanimously.
Authorized the Town Assessor to abate $2,687.00 in taxes, Tax Abatement Request No. 670, unanimously.
Granted tourist accommodations and victualing licenses to Fairfield by Marriott South Kingstown, unanimously.
Granted a victualing license renewal to Sweet Althea’s, 542 Kingston Road, unanimously.
Granted 17 victualing license renewals for the year beginning December 1, 2026, unanimously.
Granted shellfish, farm produce peddler, and farm retail sales licenses to Brandon Family Farm, unanimously.
Granted a farm retail sales license renewal to The Farmers Daughter, 716 Mooresfield Road, through the consent agenda.
Granted a miscellaneous peddlers license renewal to Allume Chocolate, 473 Main Street, unanimously.
Granted tourist accommodations license renewals to Sugar Loaf Hill Bed and Breakfast and Admiral Dewey Inn, unanimously.
Granted a trailer park/campground license renewal to Worden Pond Family Campground, unanimously.
Granted a theater license renewal to Theatre By The Sea, 364 Cards Pond Road, unanimously.
Authorized the Town Clerk to advertise a public hearing on renewal of liquor licenses for December 1, 2026, unanimously.
Authorized the Town Clerk to advertise a public hearing on a Class B victualer liquor license transfer to Acqua Pazza LLC, unanimously.
Granted a road race license to Mews Tavern for the Gear N’ Beer 5K on November 22, 2026, unanimously.
Granted a Class F 19-Hour Beverage License to South County Health for the Mews Tavern race, unanimously.
Granted a temporary mass gathering permit to Sons of Liberty for the Whiskey Wonderland event, unanimously.
Granted a renewal of the Indoor Shooting Range License for Elite Indoor Gun Range, 371 Rose Hill Road, unanimously, after a public hearing.
Approved the final roster of 60 names and the inscription wording for the Brave Men as Ever Fought memorial, unanimously.
Authorized the Town Clerk to advertise a public hearing on amendments to the snow shoveling exemption in Town Code Chapter 16, unanimously.
Authorized a contract with GZA Environmental for Saugatucket Road culvert engineering, increasing the amount to $132,289, unanimously.
Authorized a contract with K&M Communications (The Navicon Group) for library security cameras, $44,086.85, unanimously.
Authorized the Town Manager to award contracts for new South Kingstown High School technology, not to exceed $1,892,556.56, unanimously.
Received and placed on file the resignation of Terrence Simpson as registered agent for the School Funds trustees, and directed a letter of thanks, unanimously.
Referred the Pond Street residents' letter on a three-way stop sign and speed signs to the Town Manager's office for a traffic study, unanimously.
Sealed the minutes of the closed executive session held under the real property exemption, unanimously.
